subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Space and shape: Position, directions and 2D shapes
source.subtopic: Recognise, name, describe, sort and compare 2D shapes; range of shapes; features of shapes

show.line: Flat shapes! A triangle has three straight sides. A square has four equal sides. A circle has one curved side.

rounds.praise: Yes! A triangle has three sides.

rounds.prompt: Count the sides of this shape. How many?
rounds.praise: Four sides! It is a rectangle.

rounds.prompt: This shape has four equal sides and four corners. What is it called?
Which shape has no straight sides and no corners?
rounds.praise: Yes! A circle is round all the way.

rounds.prompt: Which shape has four sides, two long and two short?
rounds.praise: Yes! A rectangle has two long sides and two short sides.

rounds.prompt: Straight sides or curved sides? Put each shape in its group.
Count the corners on this triangle. How many?

hints: Count the sides with your finger. One, two, three.
A corner is where two sides meet.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say how many sides a square has.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A square has four sides. A triangle has three.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. One, two, three, four. Four sides!

parent_line: Can name flat shapes and say how many sides and corners they have.
